reconcile.source: function reconcile(full,prefix,suffix,history){assert.equal(full.length,2784);assert.deepEqual(history,{original_attempts:332,successful_prefix:331,failed_original_seq:331,failed_target:RETRY_TARGET,original_failure_retained:true,original_failure_has_png:false});assert.equal(prefix.length,331);for(let i=0;i<331;i++){assert.deepEqual(prefix[i].target,full[i],'immutable prefix identity');assert.equal(prefix[i].valid,true,'unverified prefix cannot count');}assert.ok(suffix.length<=2453);for(let i=0;i<suffix.length;i++){assert.deepEqual(suffix[i].target,full[i+331],'suffix skipped/repeated/wrong target');assert.equal(suffix[i].valid,true,'unknown/failed native is not credit');assert.equal(suffix[i].context_complete,true,'missing source/error-stage context cannot count');}return{complete:suffix.length===2453,immutable_completed_prefix:331,new_credited_targets:suffix.length,union_credited_targets:331+suffix.length,expected_union_targets:2784,original_failed_attempt_retained:true,recollected_failed_obligation:suffix.length>0?RETRY_TARGET:null,total_historical_attempts:332+suffix.length,global_ui_pass:false,full_project_approved:false};}
